name: Phantyx
source:
Humans and demons have shared this world for as long as anyone can remember. Their coexistence has been anything but peaceful, and many bloody wars have been fought. Then, suddenly, the demons disappeared.

It looked like everything was slowly returning to normal.

Then the ghosts appeared.

That's why [b]Phantyx[/b] was created, a special taskforce to deal with this new threat.

You're a highly ranked ghost hunter who joined Phantyx at fourteen, following in your parents' footsteps. With eight years of experience under your belt, you're known for being quick and efficient, but most of all:

[b]Merciless.[/b]

Because this fight is personal. After your parents were killed, you made a promise:

To keep fighting.

Until every last ghost is gone.

But what will it take to keep that promise?
